candidate.definition_en: A continuous flow of liquid, air, or people; or a small, narrow river.
candidate.explanation_ar: تيار متدفق (سواء ماء، هواء، أو حركة مستمرة)، أو جدول ماء ونهر صغير.

senses.definition_en: A continuous flow of liquid, air, gas, or people moving in one direction.
senses.definition_ar: تيار أو تدفق مستمر لشيء ما في اتجاه معين
examples: A stream of cold air came into the room.
The company has a steady stream of income.
There is a small stream near my house.
There is a small stream near my house.
A stream of cold air came into the room.
The company has a steady stream of income.
candidate.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Street' (شارع).. الـ 'Stream' هو شارع المية الجاري.. أو تذكر 'Live Stream' (بث مباشر يتدفق باستمرار).
